headline: UK and EU reach draft agreement to reduce food export regulatory barriers
summary: The UK and EU agreed on a draft deal to eliminate Brexit red tape surrounding food exports ahead of an upcoming summit.
why: Trade agreements between the UK and the European Union impact cross-border commerce, supply chain costs, and regulatory compliance for food and agricultural producers operating in both markets.

impacts.name: Consumer Staples
impacts.why: Reduction of export red tape may alter operational costs for food producers trading between the UK and EU.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
